/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | rg '/(TextInput|Modal).*d.ts"'$'"' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts && cat node_modules/react-markdown/readme.md | head -70 && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'

p=Path('src/App.tsx')
s=p.read_text().replace('maxLength={150} hasClear required', 'controlProps={{maxLength: 150, required: true}} hasClear')

PY
